Barcelona have won six of the last seven Clásicos, despite four successive defeats against Real Madrid immediately beforehand. The last 20 meetings between these two heavyweights have produced 81 goals, meaning one is scored every 23 minutes on average.

So, ahead of this biggest game in club football, check out our preview, predictions, team news and TV info.

Barcelona vs Real Madrid match info

At the back, Mourinho has a decision to make; Antonio Rüdiger partnered Dean Huijsen on Wednesday, but Ibrahima Konaté is expected to displace one or the other here.
